transcript: Claude Code can now reverse engineer any app on your own computer down to its every feature, completely free. This is called Reverse Engineer Anything, and it's a free and open-source tool that just crossed 40,000 stars on GitHub. You just install it and point it at any desktop app, mobile app, or website, and it'll decompile the whole thing and pull out all of its code. Then it'll trace back to how each feature works, all the way from your click to the final output, and it'll explain it to you all step-by-step. Plus, it also helps you rebuild that same feature for your own product, based on your own coding stack. Want to try this for yourselves? Just comment "coding" down below, and I'll send you the link directly.
